title: Recover the move beneath the stack
description: Which first instruction completes the sequence?
question: Use the 3 x 2 x 3 board. Each pair shows the same stack from opposite sides. Coordinates (x,y,z) follow the axes, starting at zero. Move the cube at the named current cell one unit. An occupied target swaps with the mover. An empty elevated target needs support immediately before the move. After each step, settle every column downward, preserving its order. Equal colors are interchangeable. The first instruction is missing. Then execute (1,0,0) x- / (0,1,0) y-. Which first instruction completes the sequence?

answer.explanation: blue (1, 0, 0) to (2, 0, 0), magenta falls from (1, 0, 1) to (1, 0, 0). Then magenta (1, 0, 0) to (0, 0, 0). Then cyan (0, 1, 0) to (0, 0, 0), exchanging with magenta. Every displayed constraint matches.
